description: arXiv:2608.23752v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required.
